evals.prompt: Can you fetch the content from https://example.com and give me the text?
evals.expected_output: The fetched content from example.com returned as clean markdown text
assertions: The output contains the page content, not an error
The content is formatted as readable text/markdown

evals.prompt: I need to read this article: https://agentskills.io/skill-creation/evaluating-skills. Can you grab it for me?
evals.expected_output: The full article content about evaluating skills, returned as clean markdown
assertions: The output includes the article title
The output contains the main body content with sections

evals.prompt: Fetch https://httpbin.org/status/404 and tell me what happens
evals.expected_output: An error or empty result indicating the page could not be fetched (404)
assertions: The output indicates the fetch failed or returned empty
The agent informs the user about the error
